policy: Prompts are hash-pinned segmentation instructions, not ground-truth masks.
SAM2 score proposes multimask hypotheses but does not determine benchmark suitability.
A preferred_mask_index may be recorded only after exact visual review of all variants for the pinned provider/checkpoint/prompt contract.
Optional largest_connected_component cleanup is deterministic and must still be visually reviewed on the final derivative.
Every selected derivative remains model-input blocked until exact source/pixel/PNG hashes pass the visual approval gate.
If source hash, prompt geometry, provider revision, checkpoint hash, mask selection or cleanup changes, prior derivative approval is stale.
The prompt set must exactly cover active segmentation/manual-cleanup blockers in the deterministic candidate manifest.

prompts.rationale: Target the central/front Hulk while excluding head inset, rear-view panel and scale-comparison figure.
prompts.selection_rationale: Exact multimask review selected m0 because it preserves the complete primary figure more faithfully than the SAM-score alternative; largest-component cleanup removes disconnected specks/insets.

prompts.selection_rationale: Mask m0 preserves the complete primary front figure; largest-component cleanup removes the disconnected head-inset fragment and specks. The SAM-score winner m2 erodes both arms.

prompts.rationale: Cover the complete primary ShengYuan Thing while explicitly suppressing the branded center stand/logo and the lower base under both feet. Positive points retain torso, fists and both legs; multiple lower negatives target the observed run-10 contamination without touching the figure.
prompts.selection_rationale: Run 10 showed that m0 preserved the figure but retained branded stand/logo pixels. Because the prompt geometry is now refined, the previous mask-index choice is stale; rerun all multimask hypotheses and review the exact cleaned derivative before selecting or approving one.
